name: wh
description: Provenance-tracked research assistant: a Neo4j knowledge graph over your files.

interface.shortDescription: Research with a provenance-tracked knowledge graph
interface.longDescription: Wheeler records research as a graph: findings, hypotheses, datasets, scripts and executions, wired together with W3C PROV relationships. Claims cite graph nodes, a script whose hash stops matching disk marks everything downstream of it stale, and each act is a mode with its own tool access.
defaultPrompt: What does the knowledge graph say about this dataset?
